general.title: Movement
general.description: How the shutters spare their motors: small comfort movements are left out, the shutters wait a while between two comfort movements, and when many shutters move together, their motors start one after the other. Comfort movements are those of the daily routine, for example.

motor_min_change.label: Minimum change
motor_min_change.description: A comfort movement smaller than this is left out. 0 turns this off. A shutter is still moved fully open or fully closed, however small the remaining distance. This works only for covers that report their position; a cover that reports none is always moved.

motor_min_interval.label: Minimum interval
motor_min_interval.description: The shortest time between two comfort movements of the window, so that a shutter does not keep moving back and forth. 0 turns this off. Something new, such as the start of the morning or the evening, still moves the shutter at once.

stagger_gap.label: Gap between motors
stagger_gap.description: When many shutters move at the same time, their motors start one after the other. After each motor of this window, the next motor, of this window or another one, waits this many seconds. 0 turns this off for this window: its covers start together when its turn comes. Between the covers of one window the gap only matters if the window has several.

reevaluate_after.label: Check again at the latest after
reevaluate_after.description: When a movement has to wait for something whose end cannot be known, for example for a cover to become available again, the window is checked again after this time at the latest.
